name: Fairmont Kea Lani, Maui
positioning: Oceanfront resort of suites and villas near Polo Beach in Wailea, Maui, with palace-like architecture (official name Fairmont Kea Lani)
best_for: Families and groups who want a suite or a villa with a kitchen and plunge pool
Guests who want a resort pool complex and a short path to the beach

facts.text: The resort is within steps of Polo Beach in Wailea, Maui.
Fairmont Kea Lani is made up entirely of suites and villas.
The one-bedroom suites have a lanai with garden or ocean views.
The two-story villas have a private courtyard and plunge pool.
The villas have a gourmet kitchen.
Poolside Suites open from the patio directly to the pool.
Nick's Fishmarket serves fresh seafood and is known for a strawberry flambé dessert.
Ko Restaurant serves Hawaiian-inspired cuisine, and Pilina is a lobby lounge and sushi bar.
The Hawaii Royal Chapel, with a gazebo, is available for weddings.
The Shops at Wailea are a short walk south of the resort.

highlights.text: AMA Bar & Grill has a swim-up bar with submerged seats, and cocktails can be served in a fresh pineapple.
The on-site cultural center, Hale Kukuna, offers hands-on classes such as lei making and ukulele lessons.
The main pool area is lagoon-style, with waterfalls, hidden hot tubs, a waterslide and a shallow wading pool for kids.
The architecture is palace-like and inspired by the white plumeria flower.

considerations.text: The resort overlooks Polo Beach, reached by a short path to the waterfront.
The property has ADA-compliant suites and villas, and recommends contacting it directly about specific accessibility needs before arrival.
WhataHotel notes that the large resort property requires walking distances between amenities.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Kea Lani
